institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: High perishability of leafy vegetables leading to material waste and economic loss.
description: A process for producing ready-to-cook dehydrated leafy vegetables such as amaranth, spinach, coriander, fenugreek, and mint. The technology extends the shelf life of highly perishable greens using a jacketed kettle with agitation, RADD, and vacuum packaging.
applications: • Manufacturing of instant ready-to-cook vegetable ingredients • Production of commercial dried herbs and seasonings • Processing of shelf-stable emergency food supplies • Formulation of dehydrated ingredients for packaged food products
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
